'''Jreizel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant living during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] at [[Outpost Thorazan]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jreizel appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Stims vendor on Tatooine.
